summary: Wrote a 4-phase plan implementing the user's recorded Option B route: a PTY-proxying wrapper at lua/neotex/plugins/ai/sapience/sf1_proxy.py that launches sf1 under its own pseudo-terminal and inserts a separator at the three message-part boundaries sf1 leaves bare. Phase 1 builds the re-verified marker contract plus a pure, pty-free stream filter with unit tests; Phase 2 adds the pty harness (winsize/signal propagation, exit-status passthrough, three degradation paths); Phase 3 wires a validated styling option and self-relative proxy-path resolution into init.lua with fallback to the bare sf1 command; Phase 4 documents and runs the full gate. Confirmed the route discharges its recorded obligation: every edit is inside this repo and ~/.sapience/sf1.py is never written, so the vendor's daily auto-update cannot lose the fix.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan for the sf1 PTY-proxy stream filter, its Lua wiring with fallback, and the full gate.
